sloka: तथेति प्रतिजग्राह रामवाक्यं विभीषणः ।राजा राक्षसमुख्यानां राघवाज्ञामनुस्मरन् ।। ७.१०८.३२ ॥
transliteration: tatheti pratijagrāha rāmavākyaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।rājā rākṣasamukhyānāṁ rāghavājñāmanusmaran ।। 7.108.32 ॥

translations.english: King Vibhishana, remembering Rama's command, accepted Rama's words, saying "So be it."
